description: Plan-first recommendation files (PLAN-plan-first.md). The payload launcher (scripts/robinhood_payload.py) fetches Robinhood data; the program computes {ticker, usd, ref_id} per slot and the buying agent reads only that. max_age_minutes is the freshness rule the operator set on 2026-10-13: the agent uses the newest file for its slot stamped at or before now, on the same ET trading day, no older than this; otherwise it buys nothing. lookahead_minutes lets each cycle also compute for the next slot when that slot opens within this many minutes, so the agent firing at the slot's start already finds a file for its own slot. The publish block mirrors the agent payload (never prices) to places a cloud agent can read; both default off until the operator wires them.
